note: HELD, NOT APPLIED. Proposed attachment corrections from the 22 Sep 2026 cross-check of the second tranche that no named source was checked against. NOTHING READS THIS FILE: generateLigamentSeed.ts reads ligament-attachment-corrections.json only, so every ligament here keeps its derived attachments and stays needsReview — which means the app asks it by picture and name and never grades its attachments (reviewedAttachmentIds, types/structure.ts). The reason this file exists is row n=92: a confident correction to the dorsal scaphotriquetral ligament was checked and turned out to be wrong, and the same reasoning produced several rows below.
promoteWith: Move the row into ligament-attachment-corrections.json with attachmentStructureIds, description, confirmed: true, grade: "verified" and a sources array, then rerun: npx tsx src/scripts/generateLigamentSeed.ts --min-visible 0 --traced

rows.why: The seed included the lunate, but the source names attachments only to the scaphoid and triquetrum; the ligament passes in front of the lunate and capitate rather than attaching to them, which is what the heavy lunate mesh contact reflects.
rows.reviewNote: Held despite a source: Sennwald names the scaphoid and triquetrum and does not mention the lunate. Silence is not a denial, and the identical inference was retracted for the dorsal scaphotriquetral ligament. Cited: The anatomy of the palmar scaphotriquetral ligament - The Journal of Bone & Joint Surgery (Br) — "Its attachment to the triquetrum is substantial but that to the scaphoid is thin and fan-shaped, its fibres interdigitating with those of the radioscaphocapitate ligament."

minorOptional.suggestion: Add coccyx — the medial attachment is the lateral sacrum and coccyx.
The L5 transverse process is dominant; L4 is variable. Keep both but weight L5.

Consider ADDING the trapezoid: the AAHS cadaveric study found a consistent trapezoid insertion of 56.9 ± 27.0 mm², and the AJR review notes a dorsal proximal trapezium attachment in about half of individuals. Graded verified, but it is an addition to the one row whose other proposed change was retracted, so it is held for a decision rather than applied.
